import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { NavigationItem, LinkData } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class SideNavigation extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        currentId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        expandedIds: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultExpandedIds: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        parentLink: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: readonly NavigationItem[];
    currentId: string;
    expandedIds: readonly string[] | undefined;
    defaultExpandedIds: readonly string[] | undefined;
    parentLink: LinkData | undefined;
    private state;
    constructor();
    private initial;
    get committedIds(): readonly string[];
    private toggle;
    private list;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
